notes: Profile post reporting captures the selected actor synchronously before launching asynchronous work, so a queued navigation cannot retarget the subsequent refresh.
The existing refresh guard still rechecks the visible actor before and after remote work; reporting with no selected profile keeps the previous report-without-refresh behavior.
The hermetic test gives the queued destination an immediate cache entry and proves that it receives only its own observer read rather than an additional refresh from the older report.
This focal reduction does not rerun or replace the existing Android, Web and iOS PROF-CONTENT evidence. It does not certify backend report failure, permissions, retry UI or unrelated profile races.
After the navigation candidate was rebased, this product patch rebased with the same stable patch-id 50b82863834a3faf8ab60fbaf8d0a559e68ab436; the affected Wasm test was rerun on the new Product SHA.
